2020: The league started on ESPN as the SP Dynasty League, with a 23-round snake draft on Sept. 2, 2020. In November it moved to Sleeper as a keeper league, bringing rosters over in a 25-round draft. The toilet-bowl punishment and the first "corrupt commish" poll both date to that December.
2021: The biggest year of change. The keeper league became full dynasty in February, the first rookie draft (1QB, snake) wrapped on May 3, max PF became the draft-order rule on May 25, and the league voted in superflex a week later. It's also the year chook (colinhook) went 0–14.
2022: Breece Hall went 1.01 in the first superflex rookie draft, and Kenny Pickett became the first QB ever taken in a superflex first round. A taxi squad was voted down 3–1, and the buy-in stayed put.
2023: Mbort took over georgebez's team. Bijan Robinson went 1.01, Lamb Talk (natelivingston) went 14–0 in the regular season, and the toilet-bowl trophy was renamed The Hook Cup after colinhook's third straight.
2024: The buy-in rose to $50 with new payouts and a draft lottery. The league voted 8–1 to expand to 12, ran an expansion draft for two new owners, then voted 8–2 to remove them weeks later. Rookie drafts went linear, and Marvin Harrison Jr. went 1.01.
2025: Ashton Jeanty went 1.01 and the rookie draft got a 24-hour pick timer. Four years after an 0–14 season, colinhook's rebuild peaked.
2026: Jeremiyah Love went 1.01. The season is still being played.
